cohort: The study participants were patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean delivery with prophylactic resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA).
finding: Patients with placenta increta, percreta, lower hemoglobin levels, and elevated D-dimer levels had an increased risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage during cesarean delivery, even with REBOA intervention.
